purpose: Controlled regression matrix for the School Document Pipeline. These are test cases and acceptance criteria; no production data is mutated by this file.

cases.expected: BSEB authority; meaningful admission subject; valid date when present; category admission
education authority; concise subject; date/reference extracted independently
district/office authority where explicitly present; no authority invented from person names
Tesseract hin+eng fallback; usable OCR text; confidence reflects quality
same SHA-256 detected; second record marked duplicate and not publicly published
processing failure retained; no automatic publication; recovery/manual-review path available
display_filename is contextual; original_filename remains unchanged for audit
published only after required safety checks; public URL and approval state consistent

production_rules: Never use real student personal data as a test fixture when a synthetic fixture is sufficient.
Do not mutate B2 or Google Drive during offline CI tests.
A failed test must block promotion of the code change, not alter existing production records.
